theme: Two days to Croatia — clear the runway from dry land.
greeting: A quiet Sunday in St. Pete with the girls, Dan, and the calendar's wide open — which is exactly the room today needs. Everything points at one thing: the Croatia bookings that have to be locked before you fly Tuesday and lose signal.

needsAttention.title: Car rental hedge - last call Sept 7
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 20-Oct 5 backup SUV has a hard decision point tomorrow: if Mike's car transport isn't booked with a written delivery window by then, keep the refundable rental and stop hedging. It's the final look before you're airborne.

needsAttention.title: Three Croatia P1s still open
needsAttention.detail: All have to be locked from dry land before Tuesday: the Sept 19 Cavtat night after the charter, the Sept 20-22 St. Pete landing gap, and written proof the checked bags are actually on the Eurowings ticket. Charter connectivity won't let you fix these underway.

needsAttention.title: Halloween - St. Pete or Maine
needsAttention.detail: Due Sept 5 and still open. The call drives three downstream bookings, and the Oct 18 St. Pete rotation fires while you're mid-Adriatic. Better decided from the couch today than from a boat next week.

needsAttention.title: Reach the Nautilus instructor
needsAttention.detail: Confirm the Sat Sept 12 boarding time and location, and arrange the Sept 19 return transfer to the airport - worth doing now while you still have bandwidth and a signal.

flagged.title: Andrew Kaufmann reconnecting
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn InMail picking the thread back up since last December - he asks whether you're still at the old firm and says he'd still welcome the chance to talk. A networking reply worth a few minutes.

inbox.noise: The rest of the inbox is newsletters and Labor Day sales - NYT Cooking, WSJ, Bloomberg, Kayak, garden shops.

recipe.title: Kabocha squash, yukon gold potatoes & cipolline
recipe.why: Early autumn is when winter squash and cipolline come into the market, and they roast down sweet together.

tasks.title: Build and pack the travel larder bin
Buy EU plug adapters + a US power strip

acts.line: The 9 AM board sweep with Mike is done and nothing else is booked - the day is open water.
The clearest stretch you'll get before Tuesday; the Croatia bookings are what it's for.
The girls are in the house through the weekend, and the Nautilus videos sit at 68% if a quiet hour opens up.
